memory_ledger.phase_allocator_peak_scope: boundary is sampled before reset and includes prior work/warmup; the reset follows boundary, so later phase peaks are cumulative within this diagnostic segment, not per-phase increments

saved_for_backward.additional_scope: excludes storage already owned by parameters/slots/input/incoming state at the segment boundary
saved_for_backward.lifetime: unique simultaneous storage held by packed objects; release on object destruction, not on unpack; repeated save payload counted separately
saved_for_backward.hook_scope: outer PyTorch saved_tensors_hooks; nested hook overrides/custom opaque backend allocations may not be visible

runtime.materialization_definition: logical output bytes from dispatched copy/index/concatenate operations; not hardware bus traffic, bandwidth or all operand loads
runtime.instrumentation: intrusive train diagnostic covering forward/readout/loss/backward/optimizer; with saved_tensors_hooks, without semantic WorkAudit hooks; not normal throughput timing

memory_ledger.work_measurement: not observed in this ledger; use a separate semantic WorkAudit pass/reference
memory_ledger.measurement: intrusive diagnostic; no normal timing/throughput result
memory_ledger.objective_scope: summed per-chunk squared readout divided by total elements; same mean-square formula with a distinct reduction order; storage witness, no timed-update equivalence claim

boundary.normal: ordinary resident-input run_stream full updates or run_request zero-state requests; constructor, hashes, observers and IO excluded
boundary.training: synthetic mean-square joined backbone readout, no task head or model-quality claim; chunks retain graphs until update
boundary.inference: first available backbone output, prefill and continuing stable decode; no task head, sampling or LM TTFT
boundary.comparisons: same-source Tide execution variants at identical semantic config; fixed-depth Transformer is auxiliary, not A-D or output equivalence
boundary.diagnostics: untimed separate work/storage passes after all ordinary samples; training restores the warmed first-sample anchor
boundary.memory: normal allocator peaks sampled before checks; RSS is process lifetime; ledger de-duplicates visible storage and leaves allocator residual unclassified
boundary.repeats: one invocation is one finite repeat; serial paired order and at least three repeats belong to the external driver

initial_parameters.scope: dense initial named Parameters before ownership placement; shape/name/raw contiguous bytes

normal_summary.boundary: ordinary continuing full updates only; repeated resident input, graph across chunks, detach after each update; diagnostic timings excluded
